checkpoints.quote: **Body:** `To keep using mobile app, please log in to Online Banking and fill the customer's questionnaire.`
checkpoints.reason: The analysis quotes the exact dialog title and body text matching the screenshot.

checkpoints.quote: Button:** `OK` (the only action — tapping it dismisses the dialog and the user is stuck on the login screen; there is no in-app path past it).
checkpoints.reason: It correctly notes the single OK button leaves the user stuck on the login screen, over the Online Banking credentials screen.

The analysis never draws the inference that the block occurs before authentication due to the empty password field; instead it states elsewhere that the dialog appears 'after entering credentials', which conflicts with this idea.

checkpoints.quote: The reporter reproduced it on a test account (`TESTRELAXLUX4`), so it is not specific to one customer.

checkpoints.quote: Product/Design decision (owner to confirm): define expected behaviour — hard block vs. warning vs. deep‑link to the web questionnaire. This unblocks the build fix (Tom Becker's question).

The stated error text matches the screenshot exactly with no invented code or wording.
The analysis explicitly states the user remains stuck on the login screen with no way to continue, not that they can proceed into the app or that a password was rejected.

unsupported_claims.quote: after entering credentials, an "Error!" dialog tells the user to log in to Online Banking (web) and complete a "customer's questionnaire", and offers no way to continue in the app.
unsupported_claims.reason: This claims the dialog appears after credentials (implying password) were entered, but the same analysis elsewhere notes the password field is empty, so this is unsupported and internally inconsistent with the screenshot facts.
